node.title: Re^3: Remove all duplicates after regex capture
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Note that [FreeBeerReekingMonk]'s solution only works because it relies on the blah on the line "title:#this is text I do not want# blah", and it only grabs the first title:. If I remove the blah or reorder the lines in the third example, it does not work.
